terms.gloss: an aim, a purpose one has set oneself

terms.gloss: the end aimed at, a goal
evidence: Quint. 2.17.22: fīnem aliquem prōpositum, ad quem tendunt (Lewis & Short)

terms.gloss: the turning-post; the end one is making for

evidence: Verg. A. 3.714: longārum haec mēta viārum (Lewis & Short)
